svg.title: Ramatama Tours: Travel agency suite where a quotation becomes a booking, an invoice and a receipt, with AR, AP and role-based access.
svg.desc: Project card for Ramatama Tours, showing real screenshots of the desktop and mobile layouts. Travel agency suite where a quotation becomes a booking, an invoice and a receipt, with AR, AP and role-based access. Built with React, React Router, Tailwind, Framer Motion.
